attachments.origin_landmark: oblique head: capitate + bases of 2nd/3rd metacarpals (carpals_r/metacarpals_r); transverse head: anterior shaft of 3rd metacarpal
attachments.insertion_landmark: proximal phalanx of thumb (ulnar side) + ulnar sesamoid, via adductor aponeurosis into the extensor expansion

actions: adducts thumb CMC/MCP toward the palm (key/lateral pinch prime mover)

functional_compartments.name: Oblique head
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: ulnar n., deep branch, proximal twig
functional_compartments.function_note: More proximal/oblique pull, contributes to thumb flexion component of adduction.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.method: actual spindle count divided by the count predicted from muscle mass, by Banks' allometric correction
relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.notes: Comparable across muscles of different size because it is normalised by predicted count rather than by mass.
relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.source: Xie P, Jiang Y, Zhang X, Yang S, 'The Study of Intramuscular Nerve Distribution Patterns and Relative Spindle Abundance of the Thenar and Hypothenar Muscles in Human Hand', PLoS One 7(12):e51538 (2012), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0051538 -- 40 hands from 20 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's stain with haematoxylin-eosin spindle counts

functional_compartments.name: Transverse head
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: ulnar n., deep branch, distal twig

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: converging fan endplate band near the insertion tendon

functional_compartments.function_note: Purely transverse pull, the more powerful pure-adduction compartment; architecturally distinct fan-shaped origin from the 3rd metacarpal shaft.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.method: actual spindle count divided by the count predicted from muscle mass, by Banks' allometric correction
relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.notes: Comparable across muscles of different size because it is normalised by predicted count rather than by mass.
relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.source: Xie P, Jiang Y, Zhang X, Yang S, 'The Study of Intramuscular Nerve Distribution Patterns and Relative Spindle Abundance of the Thenar and Hypothenar Muscles in Human Hand', PLoS One 7(12):e51538 (2012), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0051538 -- 40 hands from 20 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's stain with haematoxylin-eosin spindle counts

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the palm at the midpoint of the second and third metacarpals.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial to the second and third metacarpal cortices.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Triangular. The transverse and oblique heads can be targeted separately.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Its spasticity resists thumb abduction and directly degrades grasp and pinch.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part I -- Distal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(3):107 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17030107

relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.method: actual spindle count divided by the count predicted from muscle mass, by Banks' allometric correction
relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.notes: Extramuscular nerve trunk length 0.72 +/- 0.19 cm. Comparable across muscles of different size because it is normalised by predicted count rather than by mass.
relative_muscle_spindle_abundance.source: Xie P, Jiang Y, Zhang X, Yang S, 'The Study of Intramuscular Nerve Distribution Patterns and Relative Spindle Abundance of the Thenar and Hypothenar Muscles in Human Hand', PLoS One 7(12):e51538 (2012), doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0051538 -- 40 hands from 20 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's stain with haematoxylin-eosin spindle counts

notes: Both heads are supplied by the deep branch of the ulnar nerve, and the source counts them as separate nerve compartments. The oblique head's branch is the thicker of the two, its intramuscular arborisation is denser, and its spindle abundance is higher (0.39 against 0.34), so the source treats the oblique head as the functionally dominant one for pinch and joint stability. Where a single injection must be chosen, that is the head the anatomy points to.

trigger_points.location_description: Pincer palpation of the first web space from both sides, between the oblique and transverse heads.
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: Aching pain along the outer (radial) side of the thumb and the base of the thumb distal to the wrist crease, with spillover into the thenar eminence, first web and dorso-palmar thumb -- the pattern most often mislabelled 'arthritis of the thumb'.
trigger_points.activation_perpetuating_factors: Strong sustained pinch and twisting (weeding, pruning shears, jar lids, chopsticks, smartphone 'texting thumb', surgical needle-holders); trigger points commonly persist after healed hand fractures.
trigger_points.notes: Needle from the dorsal web with the thumb abducted, staying distal to the radial artery's passage between the two heads of the first dorsal interosseous. Trigger-point pain lacks the crepitant grind and instability of CMC/UCL disease and reproduces on web-pincer compression.
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons Trigger Point Manual, Vol. 1, Ch. 39 -- as cited in this atlas's uploaded hand intrinsic muscle reference document
